name: 14-1401 (Hubble)
blurb: 14-1401, a pair of galaxies in an ongoing dry merger, seen by Hubble.
label: 141401-hubble
story: Deep ground-based images caught this galaxy tidally linked to a companion, a 'dry' merger of gas-poor galaxies. Hubble looked closer to learn how such mergers help build today's most massive ellipticals.

claims.text: 14-1401 is one of the merger pairs with a tidal connection to a secondary object
Program 10809 targets red sequence galaxies in dry mergers found in deep ground-based images, to study how such mergers shape massive ellipticals
